svg.title: Full workshop fixture and route layout
svg.desc: Dimensioned floor layout, three elevated access plans and a rear side section. One shared limb bay, enlarged bulky fixture bay, passive limb parking, two rear side elevators, moving front and aft platforms, a low pelvis gantry and loaded crane routes. Design envelopes, not implemented geometry.
